---
title: "Replication packages by journal"
---

Pick a journal (the AER, AER:Insights, an AEJ, or the main journals pooled) to see the share of its research articles with a replication package, and the number of articles, by year of print publication. Dashed lines mark the policy changes: the AER data policy (2005), the launch of the AEJs (2009), and the AEA-wide policy (2019). The green background marks the years in which the selected journal was covered by a data policy. The P&P, JEL and JEP are on the [Appendix](appendix.qmd) page.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
share = FileAttachment("data/share_by_journal_year.csv").csv({typed: true})
order = ["Main journals","AER","AER:Insights","AEJ:Applied Economics","AEJ:Economic Policy",
         "AEJ:Macro","AEJ:Micro"]
journals = order.filter(j => share.some(d => d.Journal === j))
viewof journal = Inputs.select(journals, {label: "Journal", value: "Main journals"})
sel = share.filter(d => d.Journal === journal)
policyYear = sel[0].policy_year
lastYear = d3.max(share, d => d.year)
policyLines = [{year: 2005, label: "2005: AER policy"}, {year: 2009, label: "2009: AEJs"},
               {year: 2019, label: "2019: AEA-wide"}]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  title: `${journal}: share of articles with a replication package`,
  width, height: 380, marginLeft: 50,
  x: {label: null, tickFormat: "d", domain: [1998.5, lastYear + 0.5]},
  y: {label: "Share with a package (%)", domain: [0, 100], grid: true},
  marks: [
    policyYear ? Plot.rect([{x1: policyYear - 0.5, x2: lastYear + 0.5}],
                           {x1: "x1", x2: "x2", y1: 0, y2: 100, fill: "#E1EEE3", fillOpacity: 0.7}) : null,
    Plot.ruleX(policyLines, {x: d => d.year - 0.5, stroke: "#44546A", strokeDasharray: "4,3"}),
    Plot.text(policyLines, {x: d => d.year - 0.5, y: 100, text: "label", dy: -2, textAnchor: "start", dx: 3,
                            fill: "#44546A", fontSize: 10}),
    Plot.line(sel, {x: "year", y: d => 100 * d.share, stroke: "#1B4F8A", strokeWidth: 1.5}),
    Plot.dot(sel, {x: "year", y: d => 100 * d.share, fill: "#1B4F8A", r: 3,
                   channels: {Articles: "articles", "With a package": "with_package"},
                   tip: {format: {x: "d", y: d => d.toFixed(1) + "%"}}})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="fig-notes">
<p>Blue line: share of research articles with at least one replication package.</p>
<p>${journal === "Main journals" ? "Main journals: AER, AER:Insights and AEJs pooled. No green background, because the journals came under a data policy in different years." : `Green background: years in which ${journal} was covered by a data and code availability policy (from ${policyYear}).`}</p>
<p>Dashed vertical lines: 2005 (AER data policy), 2009 (AEJs launched), 2019 (AEA-wide policy).</p>
<p>Research articles: Crossref, excluding front matter, book reviews, and editorial/administrative notes. P&P articles printed in the May AER through 2017 are counted as AEA P&P.</p>
<p>Replication packages: AEA Data and Code Repository at openICPSR (DataCite links and titles, article references, migrated supplements).</p>
<p>By year of print publication, ${d3.min(sel, d => d.year)}–${lastYear}. The current year is incomplete and is not shown.</p>
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  title: `${journal}: research articles, and articles with a replication package`,
  width, height: 320, marginLeft: 50,
  x: {label: null, tickFormat: "d", domain: [1998.5, lastYear + 0.5]},
  y: {label: "Articles", grid: true},
  color: {legend: true, domain: ["All research articles", "With a replication package"],
          range: ["#c8c8c8", "#1B4F8A"]},
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(sel, {x1: d => d.year - 0.42, x2: d => d.year + 0.42, y: "articles",
                     fill: () => "All research articles", tip: true}),
    Plot.rectY(sel, {x1: d => d.year - 0.27, x2: d => d.year + 0.27, y: "with_package",
                     fill: () => "With a replication package"}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="fig-notes">
<p>Grey bars: all research articles in ${journal}. Blue bars: articles with at least one replication package.</p>
<p>Research articles: Crossref, excluding front matter, book reviews, and editorial/administrative notes. P&P articles printed in the May AER through 2017 are counted as AEA P&P.</p>
<p>Replication packages: AEA Data and Code Repository at openICPSR (DataCite links and titles, article references, migrated supplements).</p>
<p>By year of print publication, ${d3.min(sel, d => d.year)}–${lastYear}.</p>
</div>`
```
